title: HOPE Clinical Golden Set (clinical_v1)
description: Authoring + labeling contract for the REAL clinician-authored golden set (TASK-330 Phase-0 exit prerequisite). This schema is a SUPERSET of the runtime harness.eval.models.GoldenCase: it adds the multi-rater human labels (pdsqi_raters), the adjudicated consensus (clinician_pdsqi), claim-level groundedness ground truth, safety ground truth, PHI de-identification attestation, and provenance/consent. The ClinicalGoldenSetSource loader PROJECTS a document validated by this schema down onto GoldenCase (consensus -> clinician_pdsqi; everything else preserved under metadata) so it flows into the existing judge<->clinician ICC release gate WITHOUT any change to models.py. INTEGRITY: a document with "template": true (or any case whose label_provenance is TEMPLATE-PLACEHOLDER) is structurally refused by the loader unless allow_template=True is passed, so placeholder data can never silently gate a clinical claim.

version.description: Pinned, comparable version (e.g. clinical-v1.0.0). CI pins this so eval results are comparable across runs.

description.description: What this set is, how it was authored, and its provenance summary.

template.description: TRUE marks the whole document as a non-clinical TEMPLATE/PLACEHOLDER scaffold. The loader REFUSES to project a template set into a runnable GoldenSet unless allow_template=True. Real clinician-authored sets MUST set this to false (or omit it).

cases.description: The transcript->note evaluation cases. The Phase-0 exit gate requires N >= 132 real cases (the Bonett 2002 ICC(2,1) floor for the conservative precision target rho=0.75, +/-0.075 CI half-width; see clinical_v1_spec.md).

likert.description: PDSQI-9 1-5 Likert grade (Epic instrument grade descriptors).

likertOrNa.description: A 1-5 Likert grade, or null for NA (e.g. synthesized when no abstraction is required).

pdsqiScore.description: A PDSQI-9 judgement. Field set mirrors harness.eval.models.PDSQIScore EXACTLY (eight 1-5 Likert dimensions incl. an NA-able 'synthesized', plus three 0/1 flags) so it projects onto GoldenCase.clinician_pdsqi with no transformation.

citation.description: Are assertions correctly cited to the source notes?

accurate.description: Is the summary free of factual errors / fabrication / falsification?

thorough.description: Does it capture all pertinent information (no harmful omissions)?

succinct.description: Is it free of redundancy / padding?

synthesized.description: Quality of synthesis/abstraction; null (NA) when no abstraction was required.

abstraction.description: 1 if abstraction was required to produce the note.

voice_summ.description: 1 if the SUMMARY contains stigmatizing language.

voice_note.description: 1 if the SOURCE NOTES contain stigmatizing language.

rater.description: One clinician's INDEPENDENT PDSQI-9 rating of generated_note. >= 3 raters per case are required for the human inter-rater reliability (ICC among clinicians) that establishes the consensus label is trustworthy. Raters score blind to one another and to the model's score.

rater_id.description: STABLE PSEUDONYM ONLY (e.g. rater-A). Never a real name/NPI/email — rater identity mapping is held off-repo by the clinical lead.

rater_role.description: Rater's clinical qualification (e.g. 'Attending, Internal Medicine', 'PGY-3 Family Medicine').

blinded.description: Confirms this rating was produced blind to other raters and to the model output. MUST be true for the rating to count toward IRR.

adjudication.description: How the per-rater labels were reconciled into clinician_pdsqi (the consensus). Required when there is dispersion among raters (see spec: any dimension where raters differ by >= 2 Likert points triggers adjudication).

method.description: mean/median = automatic aggregation of rater scores; panel_adjudicated/senior_override = a human resolved a >=2-point disagreement.

adjudicator_id.description: Pseudonymous id of the senior adjudicator (panel/override methods only).

adjudicated_dimensions.description: Which PDSQI dimensions required human adjudication (had >=2-point spread).

claim.description: A claim-level groundedness GROUND TRUTH unit. Mirrors the production NER-derived citationsMap claim shape (id/text/section/evidence) used by harness.eval.inferential_corpus_eval.derive_citations_map, plus a human-adjudicated groundedness_truth label so faithfulness/groundedness signals can be scored against truth rather than a heuristic.

text.description: The atomic clinical assertion extracted from generated_note.

section.description: SOAP section the claim belongs to.

quote.description: Verbatim supporting span from a source document.

source_index.description: 0-based index into source_documents the quote came from.

groundedness_truth.description: HUMAN-ADJUDICATED ground truth: is the claim entailed by the source documents? 'contradicted' = the note asserts something the sources refute (a falsification).

safety_truth.description: Human-adjudicated SAFETY ground truth for the case (the label the safety sensor is measured against).

unsafe.description: TRUE if the generated_note contains a patient-safety-relevant defect.

categories.description: Which safety-relevant defect classes are present.

deidentification.description: Attestation that source_documents + generated_note are PHI-free. REQUIRED for every real case before it may enter the repository.

phi_free.description: MUST be true. Asserts no HIPAA 18-identifier PHI remains.

method.description: De-identification standard applied (45 CFR 164.514). 'synthetic_no_phi' = simulated content that never contained PHI.

verified_by.description: Pseudonymous id of the human who verified de-identification.

provenance.description: Where the case came from and under what authority it may be used.

dataset.description: Name + version of the public/internal dataset, if any (e.g. license-permitting MTS-Dialog, ACI-Bench).

license.description: License/usage terms governing the source (required for public_dataset).

status.description: Legal/ethical basis for using this case.

author_id.description: Pseudonymous id of the SME who authored/curated the case.

case.description: One transcript->note case. The fields case_id/source_documents/generated_note/target_specialty/role/reference_note/contexts/clinician_pdsqi project 1:1 onto GoldenCase; pdsqi_raters/adjudication/claims/safety_truth/deidentification/provenance are preserved under GoldenCase.metadata by the loader.

role.description: quality = realistic good note feeding the PDSQI quality + faithfulness gates; calibration = range-spanning/adversarial note feeding the judge<->clinician ICC only.

target_specialty.description: Clinical specialty the note targets (drives specialty stratification of the set).

source_documents.description: DE-IDENTIFIED grounding sources: transcript turns + prior notes. The entailment premise for groundedness.

generated_note.description: The draft note under evaluation. Inline <Note ID:N> markers cite source_documents[N-1] (1-based).

reference_note.description: Gold exemplar note OR a short description of why the reference is high-quality.

contexts.description: Optional explicit faithfulness contexts; defaults to source_documents when omitted.

clinician_pdsqi.description: The ADJUDICATED CONSENSUS PDSQI label. This is the human reference the judge is calibrated against (flows to GoldenCase.clinician_pdsqi -> the ICC gate). It MUST be derived from pdsqi_raters via adjudication, never authored directly.

pdsqi_raters.description: >= 3 independent clinician ratings (the inputs to human IRR and to the consensus).

claims.description: Claim-level groundedness ground truth (optional but recommended for calibration-lane cases).

metadata.description: Free-form extras. For calibration cases, document the injected 'flaw' and a 'label_rationale'. A case is treated as a TEMPLATE/PLACEHOLDER (loader-refused unless allow_template=True) when label_provenance == 'TEMPLATE-PLACEHOLDER'.
